design_description: A sleek, minimalist black and electric purple design featuring a subtle tone-on-tone pattern that adds depth and texture without overpowering the clean look. Purple double-line side panels, shoulder stripes, collar detailing and sleeve cuffs create a sharp, cohesive finish. The Galácticos crest stands out on the chest, while bold purple player names and numbers complete the back. Small fleur-de-lis details and sleeve patches add a distinctive finishing touch.
